source: Product-owner-authorized yellow, charcoal, white and gray palette migration, October 28 2026
method: Built-in imagegen palette reference, followed by deterministic Sharp normalization of all existing artwork to the four exact palette colors; original alpha channels and dimensions preserved.

prompts.paletteMigration: Recolor this exact FixxFlow logo as a palette migration reference. Preserve ribbon F with wrench, wordmark FixxFlow, tagline IT SUPPORT IN MOTION, composition and transparency. Replace red ribbon and Flow with golden yellow #FFD700. Replace dark gunmetal with charcoal #212529. White wrench #FFFFFF. Gray #ADB5BD secondary details. No new shapes or text.

derivatives: All logo variants, source masters, app icons, favicon PNGs and ICO use the yellow-and-charcoal palette. Monochrome variants retain their single-color role.
darkArtwork: Original alpha masks preserved. No backing plaque added. Launcher icons retain their intentional background.
